title: Webhook receiver conformance project configuration

test_ca_file.description: Optional project-confined CA bundle path. TLS verification cannot be disabled.

scale.description: Exact decimal rational scale in the inclusive range 0.001 through 100; never parsed through binary floating point.

$comment: Future production loaders MUST enforce MAX_CONFIG_BYTES=16777216 before parsing and MAX_CONFIG_DEPTH=64 plus MAX_CONFIG_NODES=100000 before model construction. JSON Schema cannot distinguish an integral floating-point runtime value from an integer, so the YAML/JSON loader MUST reject every floating-point lexical value before schema validation. Semantic validation must additionally verify secret-file containment under project.secret_roots, reference resolution, global event/attempt budgets, that every restart value names an enabled lifecycle profile, and that every lifecycle readiness_observer names a configured observer.

canonical_json_value.$comment: Canonical JSON admits null, booleans, safe integers, bounded strings, arrays, and objects. Floating-point lexical values are rejected by the loader before JSON Schema because JSON Schema treats 1 and 1.0 as the same mathematical value.

observer_http_timeouts.$comment: Observer HTTP connect, read, and total timeouts are positive physical monotonic durations.

duration.description: Non-negative integer duration with an explicit unit whose converted nanoseconds fit signed 64-bit; floating-point durations are prohibited.

poll_duration.description: Physical observer polling duration of at least 10 milliseconds.

typed_value.$comment: The assertion value profile exactly mirrors the nine observer evidence types; values are never coerced between branches.

observer_assertion_common.$comment: When polling is configured, model validation additionally requires poll_interval <= within after exact duration parsing.

assertion_no_partial_side_effect.$comment: Model validation additionally requires predicate names to be unique within this assertion.
